description: Defines the 'reports' namespace for generating textual game and unit statistics reports in the Wesnoth game. Includes enums for report types, a report element and report classes, and functions for report generation and content setting.

classes.name: reports::element
classes.description: Represents a report element containing either text or an image, along with a tooltip.

classes.name: reports::report
classes.description: A collection of report elements, with convenience methods for adding text and images.

methods.name: reports::generate_report
methods.description: Generates a report based on game state, map, units, teams, and other parameters.

methods.name: reports::set_report_content
methods.description: Sets specific content for a given report type.

methods.name: reports::report_name
methods.description: Returns the name of a report type.

methods.name: reports::report::add_text
methods.description: Adds text and tooltip to the report.

methods.name: reports::report::add_image
methods.description: Adds an image and tooltip to the report.
